narrative.overview: The homepage is one modernist grid poster in the Ikko Tanaka lineage. Flat colour planes sit on a twelve-column grid, the name is set in Archivo at weight 900 and cut to the grid, and a single off-centre vermilion circle is the only curve on the page. Each tool is one plane. The visitor reads the name, scans the coloured blocks, and takes the one that matches the job. Nothing floats, nothing is shaded, and nothing is decorated for its own sake. The world refuses the dark glass-card tool hub, the notebook and graph-paper metaphor, gradients, shadows, glass, and rounded corners. This is the first and so far only surface in this system; the older tool and macro pages are migration debt, not part of it.
keyCharacteristics: Flat colour planes, one per tool, with no gradients, shadows or glass.
Twelve-column grid (grid12), gap 0, max width 1440px, every block spans whole columns.
Archivo 900 for display and headings, Archivo 500 for running text.
2px ink rules are the only lines.
One vermilion circle, 220px, off-centre on the seven-column boundary, the sole curve.
Photo as a grayscale duotone plane on ochre.
Hover is a state change: brightness shift, arrow nudge, or ink inversion. Never a lift or a shadow.

rules.name: The Plane Rule
rules.body: Colour exists only as flat planes, and each plane is one tool. Planes never carry gradients or texture.

rules.name: The Ink Line Rule
rules.body: Every line on the page is a 2px solid ink rule. No other line colour is used.

rules.name: The Heavy Grotesk Rule
rules.body: Weight 900 is for the name, section heads and plane titles. Running text stays at 500. Weight 700 is only for small UI actions.

rules.name: The Twelve-Column Rule
rules.body: Every block aligns to the twelve-column unit. Horizontal positions are column counts, not pixel offsets. The circle's position is the one exception, expressed as 7/12 of the hero width.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and stay flat on hover. Planes never receive shadows, gradients or lift.

rules.name: The One Curve Rule
rules.body: The vermilion circle is the sole curve in the system. Do not add a second curve, rounded corner or pill.

dos: Do build every block on the twelve-column grid (grid12, gap 0, max 1440px), spanning whole columns.
Do set each tool as one flat colour plane with its title, description and action word, using the plane colours.
Do keep the 2px solid ink rule as the only line weight and colour.
Do keep the circle to one 220px vermilion disc, off-centre on the seven-column boundary.
Do keep the photo as a grayscale duotone plane on ochre (grayscale(1) contrast(1.1), multiply).
Do signal hover with brightness (1.08), an arrow nudge (6px), or an ink inversion for macro tiles, over 0.15-0.2s.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion by removing transitions.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, gradients, glass, blur or lift effects to any plane, tile or photo.
Don't round corners on any element except the single vermilion circle.
Don't add a second curve or a second circle to a surface.
Don't introduce lines in any colour other than ink, or in any weight other than 2px.
Don't set small text in vermilion on paper. At 3.96:1 it fails WCAG AA for text under 18.66px bold.
Don't set white text on vermilion below 18.66px bold; the contrast is 4.48:1.
Don't use graph paper, notebook covers, paper textures, or a dark glass-card layout for this surface.
Don't change the tool planes into a flat list or a card grid with rounded corners.
